COLDWAR_CHL_apply_government_change = { set_country_flag = no_leader_change change_ruling_party_effect = yes clr_country_flag = no_leader_change }

COLDWAR_CHL_record_1970_presidential_term = {
	set_country_flag = no_leader_change
	# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Resolve the outlook before native politics formatting.
	if = {
		limit = { ROOT = { has_government = democratic } }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes last_election = "1970.9.4" election_frequency = 72 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ROOT = { has_government = communism } }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = yes last_election = "1970.9.4" election_frequency = 72 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ROOT = { has_government = fascism } }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = yes last_election = "1970.9.4" election_frequency = 72 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ROOT = { has_government = neutrality } }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = yes last_election = "1970.9.4" election_frequency = 72 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ROOT = { has_government = nationalist } }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist elections_allowed = yes last_election = "1970.9.4" election_frequency = 72 }
	}
	clr_country_flag = no_leader_change
}

COLDWAR_CHL_election_count = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_calendar_active = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_ballot_counted }
		}
		hold_elections = yes
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_1 = party_pop_array^1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_1 = party_pop_array^20 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_2 = party_pop_array^2 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_2 = party_pop_array^14 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_18 = party_pop_array^18 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_18 = party_pop_array^4 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_18 = party_pop_array^3 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_18 = party_pop_array^19 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_total = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_total = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_2 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_total = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_18 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_total > 0 }
			}
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_1 = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_total }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_2 = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_total }
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_18 = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_total }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_winner_slot = 1 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_runner_up_slot = 2 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_winner_share = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_1 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_runner_up_share = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_2 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_2 > COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_1 }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_winner_slot = 2 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_runner_up_slot = 1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_winner_share = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_2 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_runner_up_share = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_18 > COLDWAR_CHL_election_winner_share }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_runner_up_slot = COLDWAR_CHL_election_winner_slot }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_runner_up_share = COLDWAR_CHL_election_winner_share }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_winner_slot = 18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_winner_share = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_18 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_18 > COLDWAR_CHL_election_runner_up_share }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_runner_up_slot = 18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_runner_up_share = COLDWAR_CHL_ticket_18 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_confirmed_slot = -1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_winner_share > 0.5 }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_confirmed_slot = COLDWAR_CHL_election_winner_slot }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_ratified
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_ballot_counted
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_update_congress_support = {
	update_majority_threshold = yes
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_congress_runner_up_in_coalition = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_congress_coalition_support = party_pop_elect_array^ruling_party }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ruling_party = COLDWAR_CHL_election_runner_up_slot }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_congress_runner_up_in_coalition = 1 }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = gov_coalition_array
		value = COLDWAR_CHL_coalition_member
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_coalition_member = COLDWAR_CHL_election_runner_up_slot }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_congress_runner_up_in_coalition = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_coalition_member = ruling_party }
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_congress_coalition_support = party_pop_elect_array^COLDWAR_CHL_coalition_member }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_CHL_install_confirmed_candidate = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_calendar_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_ratified
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_installed }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_installed
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_confirmed_slot = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_CHL_clear_coalition_parameters = yes
			set_variable = { rul_party_temp = 1 }
			set_variable = { col_one = 20 }
			set_variable = { change_leader_temp = 0 }
			set_variable = { disable_elections = 0 }
			COLDWAR_CHL_apply_government_change = yes
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_leader_slot = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_confirmed_slot = 2 }
			}
			COLDWAR_CHL_clear_coalition_parameters = yes
			set_variable = { rul_party_temp = 2 }
			set_variable = { col_one = 14 }
			set_variable = { change_leader_temp = 0 }
			set_variable = { disable_elections = 0 }
			COLDWAR_CHL_apply_government_change = yes
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_leader_slot = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_election_confirmed_slot = 18 }
			}
			COLDWAR_CHL_clear_coalition_parameters = yes
			set_variable = { rul_party_temp = 18 }
			set_variable = { col_one = 4 }
			set_variable = { col_two = 3 }
			set_variable = { col_three = 19 }
			set_variable = { change_leader_temp = 0 }
			set_variable = { disable_elections = 0 }
			COLDWAR_CHL_apply_government_change = yes
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_leader_slot = 18 }
		}
		COLDWAR_CHL_sync_native_outlook = yes
		COLDWAR_CHL_route_leader = yes
		COLDWAR_CHL_record_1970_presidential_term = yes
		COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_route_leader = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_pinochet_presidency
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Augusto Pinochet" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = {
					name = "Augusto Pinochet"
					picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/CHL_augusto_pinochet.dds"
					ideology = Nat_Autocracy
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_military_government
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_pinochet_presidency }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Chilean Military Council" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Chilean Military Council" ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_1990_winner_confirmed
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_handover
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Patricio Aylwin" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = {
					name = "Patricio Aylwin"
					picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/CHL_patricio_aylwin.dds"
					ideology = conservatism
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_installed }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Eduardo Frei Montalva" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = {
					name = "Eduardo Frei Montalva"
					picture = "gfx/leaders/CHL/CHL_Coldwar_Eduardo_Frei_Montalva.dds"
					ideology = conservatism
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_installed
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_handover }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Radomiro Tomic" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Radomiro Tomic" ideology = conservatism }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_1990_winner_confirmed
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_handover
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Hernán Büchi" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Hernán Büchi" ideology = liberalism }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_handover }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Jorge Alessandri" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Jorge Alessandri" ideology = liberalism }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Salvador Allende" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = {
					name = "Salvador Allende"
					picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/CHL_salvador_allende.dds"
					ideology = neutral_Social
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Alberto Baltra" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Alberto Baltra" ideology = socialism }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Luis Corvalán" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Luis Corvalán" ideology = communist_state }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 5 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Miguel Enríquez" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Miguel Enríquez" ideology = anarchist_communism }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 14 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Julio Durán" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Julio Durán" ideology = Neutral_conservatism }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 19 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Jacques Chonchol" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Jacques Chonchol" ideology = Neutral_Communism }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 20 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Raúl Correa Labra" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Raúl Correa Labra" ideology = Nat_Populism }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_leader = { name = "Jaime Guzmán" ruling_only = yes }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { kill_country_leader = yes }
				create_country_leader = { name = "Jaime Guzmán" ideology = Western_Autocracy }
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_politics_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_politics_initialized }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_politics_initialized
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_leader_slot = 1 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_politics_daily = {
if = {
	limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
	COLDWAR_CHL_politics_initialize = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_1970_calendar_superseded
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_military_government }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_military_government
			COLDWAR_CHL_route_leader = yes
			COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_programmes = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_military_government
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_military_government
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_pinochet_presidency
		COLDWAR_CHL_route_leader = yes
		COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_early_exit_election
			NOT = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_early_exit_term_recorded }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_early_exit_term_recorded
		set_country_flag = no_leader_change
		if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = { has_government = democratic }
			}
			set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic election_frequency = 72 elections_allowed = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = { has_government = communism }
			}
			set_politics = { ruling_party = communism election_frequency = 72 elections_allowed = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = { has_government = fascism }
			}
			set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism election_frequency = 72 elections_allowed = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = { has_government = neutrality }
			}
			set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality election_frequency = 72 elections_allowed = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = { has_government = nationalist }
			}
			set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist election_frequency = 72 elections_allowed = yes }
		}
		clr_country_flag = no_leader_change
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1970.11.2 has_stability < 0.4 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_left_bloc = party_pop_array^18 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_left_bloc = party_pop_array^4 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_left_bloc = party_pop_array^3 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_left_bloc = party_pop_array^19 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_right_bloc = party_pop_array^2 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_right_bloc = party_pop_array^14 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_left_bloc > 0.25 }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_right_bloc > 0.25 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_confrontation_days = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_confrontation_days = 0 }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_high_confrontation
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_confrontation_days = 0 }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_high_confrontation
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_confrontation_days > 30 }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_high_confrontation
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_stress_test_active
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_banking_stress_test }
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_stress_test_active
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_pinochet_chicago_applied date > 1981.12.31 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_fragile_banks
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_pinochet_handover
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_won
			date > 1989.12.13
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_1990_winner_confirmed }
		}
		COLDWAR_CHL_count_1990_election = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_event_election = yes }
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_election = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_calendar_active = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_campaign_opened
				date > 1970.9.3
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_ballot_counted }
			}
			COLDWAR_CHL_election_count = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_ballot_counted
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_ratified }
			}
			COLDWAR_CHL_update_congress_support = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_CHL_can_event_congress = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_congress_event_seen }
			}
			COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_congress = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_ratified
				date > 1970.11.2
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_installed }
			}
			COLDWAR_CHL_install_confirmed_candidate = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_event_transport = yes }
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_transport = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_event_rupture = yes }
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_rupture = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_event_junta = yes }
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_junta = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_event_banking = yes }
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_banking = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_event_andean = yes }
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_andean = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_military_government
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_repression_event_seen }
		}
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_repression = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_national_copper
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_copper_event_seen }
		}
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_copper = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_pinochet_chicago
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_adjustment_event_seen }
		}
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_adjustment = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_commission_truth
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_truth_event_seen }
		}
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_truth = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_military_ballot
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_early_exit_event_seen }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_early_exit_cooldown }
		}
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_early_exit = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_pinochet_plebiscite
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_event_seen }
		}
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_plebiscite = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_pinochet_handover
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_handover_event_seen }
		}
		COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_handover = yes
	}
}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_count_plebiscite_vote = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_vote_counted }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_total_temp = party_pop_array^1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_total_temp = party_pop_array^3 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_total_temp = party_pop_array^4 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_total_temp = party_pop_array^18 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_total_temp = party_pop_array^19 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_total_temp = party_pop_array^20 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_yes_total_temp = party_pop_array^0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_yes_total_temp = party_pop_array^2 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_yes_total_temp = party_pop_array^14 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_yes_total_temp = party_pop_array^22 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_total = COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_total_temp }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_yes_total = COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_yes_total_temp }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_total > COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_yes_total }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_won
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_yes_won }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_vote_counted
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_election = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_event_seen }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_campaign_opened }
			COLDWAR_CHL_can_event_election = yes
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL.1 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_congress = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_congress_event_seen }
			COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_calendar_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_ballot_counted
			date > 1970.10.23
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_election_ratified }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_congress_retry }
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL.2 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_copper = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_copper_event_seen }
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_national_copper
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL.3 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_transport = {

COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_early_exit = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_early_exit_event_seen }
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_military_ballot
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_constitutional_military_council
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_early_exit_cooldown }
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL.10 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_plebiscite = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_event_seen }
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_pinochet_plebiscite
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_military_government
		}
		COLDWAR_CHL_count_plebiscite_vote = yes
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL.11 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_handover = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_handover_event_seen }
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_pinochet_handover
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_plebiscite_no_won
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_civilian_1990_winner_confirmed
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL.12 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_truth = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_truth_event_seen }
			has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_repression
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CHL_commission_truth
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL.13 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_andean = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_event_seen }
			COLDWAR_CHL_can_event_andean = yes
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL.14 }
	}
}
